# Project Context for Claude

## Stack
- Language: typescript (strict TypeScript)
- Frameworks: next, react
- Package manager: npm
- Test framework: vitest

## Structure
- Source root: `src`
- Top-level folders: `e2e`, `hostinger`, `public`, `scripts`, `src`, `test-results`
- Tests folder present

## Entry points
- Entry: `src/app/` (App Router) or `src/pages/` (Pages Router)
- API routes live in `app/api/` or `pages/api/` — keep them thin, move logic to services.

## Conventions
- File naming: `mixed` (91% consistent)
- Import style: mixed
- Test framework: vitest

## Commands
- `npm run build` — `next build`
- `npm run test` — `vitest run`
- `npm run lint` — `eslint src/ --ext .ts,.tsx`
- `npm run dev` — `next dev`
- `npm run start` — `next start`

## Working agreements
- Always run `npm run test` after non-trivial changes.
- Always run `npm run lint` before finishing; fix all lint errors, never suppress warnings without justification.
- Match existing file naming (`mixed`) when creating new files.
- Prefer editing existing modules to creating new ones — check if something similar exists before scaffolding.
- Keep functions focused; extract when a function exceeds ~40 lines or has more than one responsibility.
- Add or update tests in the same commit as the implementation, not as a follow-up.
- Imports: prefer mixed imports to match the existing style.
- Prefer Server Components; use `"use client"` only when interactivity is required.
- Data fetching belongs in Server Components or Route Handlers, not in client components.
- Co-locate hooks with the component that owns them unless reused in 3+ places.
